senses.definition_en: mass vaccination centre, mass vaccination site (large facilities enabled to vaccinate)

examples.english: The word vacunódromo, which generally refers to large facilities authorized to vaccinate, is valid in Spanish.
examples.text: La voz vacunódromo, con la que se alude, generalmente, a grandes instalaciones habilitadas para vacunar, es válida en español.
examples.translation: The word vacunódromo, which generally refers to large facilities authorized to vaccinate, is valid in Spanish.

examples.english: These vaccination centers are a complement to healthcare centers and an alternative to avoid congesting them with mass immunization.
examples.ref: 2021 April 4, Pablo Linde, “España prepara los ‘vacunódromos’ para la inmunización masiva”, in El Diario:
examples.text: Estos vacunódromos son un complemento a los centros de salud y una alternativa para no congestionarlos en una inmunización masiva.
examples.translation: These vaccination centers are a complement to healthcare centers and an alternative to avoid congesting them with mass immunization.

examples.english: The ‘vacunódromo’ in Cartuja Stadium in Seville has closed its doors on Friday after more than five months of operation after starting last April 22nd to administer the first doses of the vaccine against COVID-19.
examples.ref: 2021 October 2, “Cierran el 'vacunódromo' del Estadio de la Cartuja de Sevilla tras más de cinco meses en funcionamiento”, in 20 Minutos:
examples.text: El ‘vacunódromo’ del Estadio de la Cartuja de Sevilla ha cerrado sus puertas este viernes tras más de cinco meses de funcionamiento desde que el pasado 22 de abril comenzase a administrar las primeras dosis de la vacuna contra la Covid-19.
examples.translation: The ‘vacunódromo’ in Cartuja Stadium in Seville has closed its doors on Friday after more than five months of operation after starting last April 22nd to administer the first doses of the vaccine against COVID-19.

examples.english: According to their data, this word [vax] is now used 72 times as often as it was a year ago, and has given rise to a whole family of related words such as "vax sites" (‘vacunódromos’) and "being fully vaxxed" (‘to be completely vaccinated’).
examples.ref: 2021 December 31, Efe, “Vacuna la ganadora de la palabra del año en el mundo [Vacuna wins word of the year]”, in El Imparcial, “Vax” la elección de Oxford [Oxford selects “vax”]:
examples.text: De acuerdo con sus datos, esa palabra [vax] se usa ahora 72 veces más que hace un año y está dando lugar a toda una familia de voces relacionadas, desde "vax sites" ('vacunódromos') a "being fully vaxxed" ('estar completamente vacunado').
examples.translation: According to their data, this word [vax] is now used 72 times as often as it was a year ago, and has given rise to a whole family of related words such as "vax sites" (‘vacunódromos’) and "being fully vaxxed" (‘to be completely vaccinated’).

examples.english: The vaccination center, the location of which within the French capital was not specified, was announced Monday by Health Minister François Braun on the BFMTV channel.
examples.ref: 2022 July 25, “Francia abre su primer gran centro de vacunación contra viruela del mono [France opens first major center for vaccination against mpox]”, in Diario de México, Mexico City:
examples.text: Este vacunódromo, cuyo emplazamiento en la capital gala no fue precisado, fue anunciado este lunes por el ministro de Sanidad, François Braun, en el canal BFMTV.
examples.translation: The vaccination center, the location of which within the French capital was not specified, was announced Monday by Health Minister François Braun on the BFMTV channel.

glosses: mass vaccination centre, mass vaccination site (large facilities enabled to vaccinate)
